unresolved_should_improve.claim: The revision cuts three things the first draft kept. 'That's good enough, but I've got another plan' set up the Embassy as the alternative to marriage. 'You can't love me right away, of course' set up Jane's 'I love you now'. 'Now I've seen you I'm simply crazy about you' reversed Julius's earlier 'One look at the girl in the flesh, and I was cured!' What remains is a bare Embassy remark followed by the proposal, and a love grounded only in the photo.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: 'Maybe you'll never come to love me' still gives Jane's 'now' some setup.

But I’ve loved you from the very moment I set eyes on your photo--and now I’ve seen you I’m simply crazy about you!

unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: The Embassy sentence becomes a non sequitur. Jane's 'now' loses part of its contrast. Readers who remember chapter 021's 'cured' may find Julius inconsistent, because the coda no longer completes the image-to-person arc.
unresolved_should_improve.title: Proposal loses its 'another plan' connective, 'can't love me right away', and the in-person reversal

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The revision cuts 'I was determined to make you say it'. That sentence makes Tommy's debt comic revenge: he has tricked the unsentimental Tuppence into saying 'Ours'. Without it, 'I owe you something for the relentless way you've squashed me' can be read as earnest thanks.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: Tuppence's 'You think I mind saying it' still hints at a contest.

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The first draft kept 'Rather fun, wasn't it?' / 'Rather.' and 'Tommy was suddenly galvanized into life.' The revision cuts both. 'I like Julius' now leads directly to 'he said dictatorially', with no named speaker and no build-up of silence.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: Only Tommy and Tuppence are in the taxi, so the referent can be inferred. The plan allows the silence beats to collapse.

unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: Christie's comic timing works by stiff monosyllables followed by an explosion. Here the explosion arrives unprepared, and the pronoun follows a line spoken by Tuppence.
unresolved_should_improve.title: Strained small talk and 'galvanized' trigger cut; the jealous outburst lacks timing and an explicit speaker
